verdict.rationale: Drive's own sharing docs show you can share folders and files with anyone, limit people to only opening a file (view-only), and have folder access inherited by the files inside, which covers organized shared folders with view-only links. Nothing in the evidence documents download, print or copy restrictions. The only access-visibility item is an API sample that writes sharing info to a spreadsheet, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in viewer-activity feature. Missing for 10: documented download/print/copy controls, built-in access or activity visibility for who viewed shared files, independent corroboration of data-room use.
